DB=/app/oewn.sqlite
cat > /tmp/cand.sql <<'EOF'
WITH g AS (
  SELECT s.wordid AS wordid, s.synsetid AS synsetid, COUNT(*) AS c,
         syn.domainid AS domainid, syn.posid AS posid
  FROM senses s JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = s.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
),
a AS (
  SELECT wordid, COUNT(*) AS total_synsets, SUM(c) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM g
  GROUP BY wordid
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) >= 2 AND SUM(c) >= 2
),
top AS (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, c FROM (
    SELECT g.wordid, g.synsetid, g.c,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY g.wordid ORDER BY g.c DESC, g.synsetid ASC) AS rn
    FROM g JOIN a ON a.wordid = g.wordid
  ) WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT w.wordid AS word_id, w.word AS word,
       a.total_synsets, a.total_senses, a.distinct_domains, a.distinct_posids,
       top.synsetid AS top_synsetid, top.c AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM a JOIN top ON top.wordid = a.wordid JOIN words w ON w.wordid = a.wordid
ORDER BY a.total_senses DESC, a.total_synsets DESC, a.distinct_domains DESC, w.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
EOF
echo '== timing original =='
time sqlite3 -readonly "$DB" < /app/my-sql-query.sql > /tmp/orig.out
echo '== timing candidate =='
time sqlite3 -readonly "$DB" < /tmp/cand.sql > /tmp/cand.out
echo '== diff values =='
diff /tmp/orig.out /tmp/cand.out && echo SAME_VALUES
echo '== diff headers =='
sqlite3 -readonly -header "$DB" < /app/my-sql-query.sql > /tmp/orig.h
sqlite3 -readonly -header "$DB" < /tmp/cand.sql > /tmp/cand.h
diff /tmp/orig.h /tmp/cand.h && echo SAME_ALL
wc -l /tmp/orig.out
echo '== candidate plan =='
{ echo 'EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN'; cat /tmp/cand.sql; } | sqlite3 -readonly "$DB"

DB=/app/oewn.sqlite
sqlite3 --version
echo '== orphan checks =='
sqlite3 -readonly -header -column "$DB" "SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM senses s WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM words w WHERE w.wordid=s.wordid)) AS orphan_wordid_senses, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM senses s WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM synsets y WHERE y.synsetid=s.synsetid)) AS orphan_synset_senses;"
cat > /tmp/cand.sql <<'EOF'
WITH sc AS (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, COUNT(*) AS c FROM senses GROUP BY wordid, synsetid
),
agg AS (
  SELECT s.wordid AS wordid,
         COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
         COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM senses s
  JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = s.synsetid
  WHERE s.wordid IN (SELECT wordid FROM words)
  GROUP BY s.wordid
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) >= 2
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) >= 2
     AND COUNT(*) >= 2
),
top AS (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, c FROM (
    SELECT sc.wordid, sc.synsetid, sc.c,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sc.wordid ORDER BY sc.c DESC, sc.synsetid ASC) AS rn
    FROM sc
    WHERE sc.wordid IN (SELECT wordid FROM agg)
  ) WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT w.wordid AS word_id, w.word AS word,
       agg.total_synsets, agg.total_senses, agg.distinct_domains, agg.distinct_posids,
       top.synsetid AS top_synsetid, top.c AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM agg
JOIN top ON top.wordid = agg.wordid
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = agg.wordid
ORDER BY agg.total_senses DESC, agg.total_synsets DESC, agg.distinct_domains DESC, w.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
EOF
echo '== timing candidate =='
/usr/bin/time -f 'cand_elapsed %e s' sh -c "sqlite3 -readonly '$DB' < /tmp/cand.sql > /tmp/cand.out"
wc -l /tmp/cand.out
head -3 /tmp/cand.out

command:
DB=/app/oewn.sqlite
echo '== key bounds =='
sqlite3 -readonly "$DB" "SELECT MIN(synsetid), MAX(synsetid) FROM synsets; SELECT MIN(wordid), MAX(wordid) FROM senses; SELECT MAX(c) FROM (SELECT wordid,synsetid,COUNT(*) AS c FROM senses GROUP BY wordid,synsetid);"

cat > /tmp/qB.sql <<'EOF'
WITH agg AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.wordid AS wordid,
         COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
         COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         MAX(syn.posid='n') + MAX(syn.posid='v') + MAX(syn.posid='a') + MAX(syn.posid='r') + MAX(syn.posid='s') AS distinct_posids
  FROM senses s JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = s.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) >= 2
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) >= 2
     AND COUNT(*) >= 2
),
r AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM agg
  ORDER BY total_senses DESC, total_synsets DESC, distinct_domains DESC, wordid ASC
  LIMIT 500
),
sc AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.wordid AS wordid, s.synsetid AS synsetid, COUNT(*) AS c
  FROM senses s JOIN r ON r.wordid = s.wordid
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
),
top AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, c FROM (
    SELECT sc.wordid, sc.synsetid, sc.c,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sc.wordid ORDER BY sc.c DESC, sc.synsetid ASC) AS rn
    FROM sc
  ) WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT w.wordid AS word_id, w.word AS word,
       r.total_synsets, r.total_senses, r.distinct_domains, r.distinct_posids,
       top.synsetid AS top_synsetid, top.c AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM r JOIN top ON top.wordid = r.wordid JOIN words w ON w.wordid = r.wordid
ORDER BY r.total_senses DESC, r.total_synsets DESC, r.distinct_domains DESC, w.wordid ASC;
EOF

cat > /tmp/qC.sql <<'EOF'
WITH agg AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.wordid AS wordid,
         COUNT(*) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,
         COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         MAX(syn.posid='n') + MAX(syn.posid='v') + MAX(syn.posid='a') + MAX(syn.posid='r') + MAX(syn.posid='s') AS distinct_posids
  FROM senses s JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = s.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) >= 2
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) >= 2
     AND COUNT(*) >= 2
),
r AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM agg
  ORDER BY total_senses DESC, total_synsets DESC, distinct_domains DESC, wordid ASC
  LIMIT 500
)
SELECT w.wordid AS word_id, w.word AS word,
       r.total_synsets, r.total_senses, r.distinct_domains, r.distinct_posids,
       (SELECT s.synsetid FROM senses s WHERE s.wordid = r.wordid
        GROUP BY s.synsetid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.synsetid ASC LIMIT 1) AS top_synsetid,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM senses s WHERE s.wordid = r.wordid
        AND s.synsetid = (SELECT s2.synsetid FROM senses s2 WHERE s2.wordid = r.wordid
                          GROUP BY s2.synsetid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s2.synsetid ASC LIMIT 1)) AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM r JOIN words w ON w.wordid = r.wordid
ORDER BY r.total_senses DESC, r.total_synsets DESC, r.distinct_domains DESC, w.wordid ASC;
EOF

cat > /tmp/qD.sql <<'EOF'
WITH sc AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, COUNT(*) AS c
  FROM senses GROUP BY wordid, synsetid
),
cand AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT wordid FROM sc GROUP BY wordid
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 AND SUM(c) >= 2
),
g AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT sc.wordid AS wordid, sc.synsetid AS synsetid, sc.c AS c,
         syn.domainid AS domainid, syn.posid AS posid
  FROM sc JOIN cand ON cand.wordid = sc.wordid
  JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = sc.synsetid
),
a AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT wordid,
         SUM(c) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(*) AS total_synsets,
         COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         MAX(posid='n') + MAX(posid='v') + MAX(posid='a') + MAX(posid='r') + MAX(posid='s') AS distinct_posids
  FROM g
  GROUP BY wordid
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) >= 2 AND SUM(c) >= 2
),
r AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM a
  ORDER BY total_senses DESC, total_synsets DESC, distinct_domains DESC, wordid ASC
  LIMIT 500
),
top AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, c FROM (
    SELECT sc.wordid, sc.synsetid, sc.c,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sc.wordid ORDER BY sc.c DESC, sc.synsetid ASC) AS rn
    FROM sc JOIN r ON r.wordid = sc.wordid
  ) WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT w.wordid AS word_id, w.word AS word,
       r.total_synsets, r.total_senses, r.distinct_domains, r.distinct_posids,
       top.synsetid AS top_synsetid, top.c AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM r JOIN top ON top.wordid = r.wordid JOIN words w ON w.wordid = r.wordid
ORDER BY r.total_senses DESC, r.total_synsets DESC, r.distinct_domains DESC, w.wordid ASC;
EOF

for f in /tmp/v4.sql /tmp/qB.sql /tmp/qC.sql /tmp/qD.sql; do
  echo "== $f plan =="
  { echo 'EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN'; cat "$f"; } | sqlite3 -readonly "$DB" | head -30
  for i in 1 2 3; do
    out="/tmp/$(basename "$f").run$i.out"
    start=$(date +%s%N)
    timeout 60 sqlite3 -readonly "$DB" < "$f" > "$out"
    rc=$?
    end=$(date +%s%N)
    ms=$(( (end - start) / 1000000 ))
    if diff -q /tmp/cand2.out "$out" >/dev/null 2>&1; then same=SAME; else same=DIFF; fi
    echo "run$i rc=$rc ms=$ms rows=$(wc -l < "$out") $same"
  done
done
